the anomalous magnetic momentum of the muon can be explained by a dark matter model that has a tree-level interaction with leptons, and that is consistent with all other experiments.
the muon magnetic dipole anomaly can be resolved by the dark matter, but it requires a very specific dark sector.

the muon magnetic anomaly provides an additional probe of leptophilic models that is complementary to the direct detection experiments and collider searches.
